info.name: Ecommerce Platform API
info.description:
API collection for the ecommerce platform backend. Use to verify all endpoints before building the frontend.

**Setup:** Set `baseUrl` to your API root (default: http://localhost:3000).

**Staff admin:** Apply migration `20260502120000_admin_rbac`, then **Admin (staff) → Bootstrap — first super-admin** (or **Admin login**). If roles were never seeded, the API creates permissions/roles on first bootstrap. `npm run seed` still recommended for shipping/COD defaults. Collection vars `admin_access_token` / `admin_role_id` are set by Tests where noted. Customer JWT: `access_token`. **Admin - Payment methods** requires `payments.manage` (manager or super-admin); set `paymentMethodId` after create or from DB.

request.description: Create account. Returns access_token and user. Save access_token to {{access_token}} for protected routes.
Authenticate. Returns access_token and user. Save access_token to {{access_token}}.
Current user profile. Requires Bearer token.
Send email with link to set password and create account (guest checkout flow).
Set password using token from email. Returns access_token and user (logged in).
Logout. Client should discard token. Returns success message.

item.name: Admin (staff)
item.description: RBAC staff APIs. **Requires** DB migration `20260502120000_admin_rbac`. Permissions and system roles are created automatically on first bootstrap if missing (or run `npm run seed`). **First user:** **Bootstrap — first super-admin** only when `admin_users` is empty. JWT `typ: "admin"` — use `admin_access_token`.

request.description: Creates the first staff user with **super-admin** role and returns `access_token` + `user` (same as login). **Allowed only when there are zero admin users.** Tests save `access_token` → collection var `admin_access_token`.
Staff login. Response includes `user.roles`, `user.permissions`, `user.typ: "admin"`. Tests save token to `admin_access_token`.
Current staff profile + roles + effective permission keys. Requires `admin_access_token`.
Stateless logout message. Clear `admin_access_token` locally if you want.
Requires permission `admin.roles.read`. Returns roles with nested permissions. Tests set `admin_role_id` to **super-admin** id for the Create admin user request.
Requires permission `admin.users.create`. Run **List roles** first so `admin_role_id` is set, or paste UUIDs from that response into `roleIds`.
